what_this_means: Today, right after the plugin remembers which boss you were just asking about, it still gets the follow-up wrong every single time in this test -- none of the nine tries answered about the right boss. Telling the model in plain words which boss the question is carrying on from fixed about four in nine tries -- still not reliable, but a real improvement, and it never made an answer thinner. Only keeping that one boss's own note and throwing the rest away worked less often -- about two in nine, and even those two never actually named the boss, they just happened to repeat its facts without confusing them with a different one. One game, DOOM Eternal, failed under every single approach: the model simply never connected "second phase" to that boss's note, even when it was the only thing in front of it, so this is not just a search or a wording problem -- sometimes the small model on the Deck cannot make the connection at all. In every single try, under every approach, the right boss's note was in front of the model at the top of the pile -- it was never simply missing. So the fixes are not about finding the right note anymore; they are about getting the model to actually use it.
recommendation: Telling the model which thing the question is about (shape A) is the one worth shipping if either is shipped: it did better than doing nothing, never made a reply thinner or removed a usable note, and it cannot unlock a boss's spoilers by itself because the reminder is not treated as the player naming anything. It is also the cheaper change. Throwing away every other note (shape B) did not pay for its downside here -- answers got shorter without getting more often correct, and it can leave nothing at all if the remembered boss turns out to be the wrong guess. Neither fix reaches "reliable" on its own -- four right out of nine is still worse than a coin flip -- and the DOOM Eternal result says some of this gap is the small model's own reading of the note, not something a prompt tweak can close. If this ships, it should ship as a small gain worth having, not as the fix for the bug, and the DOOM Eternal case is worth another look on its own before anyone calls this closed.
not_shipped: Both shapes ran only behind the --followup-shape switch in scripts/eval_kb_answers.py, off by default. Nothing about what the plugin sends to the model changed during this measurement.
